content.short: Skymon is the first live NFT in the metaverse. These 10,000 unique fantastic creatures can make the world a better.
content.description: Skymon is the first live NFT in the metaverse. They are created each with its unique traits. No matter what colors, species, or wings a Skymon is assigned to, they are all equal. This is a project we've been spending quite a while working on. Our aim is to create digital creatures which not only bring people joy but also raise their awareness of the problems of equal rights and diversity of the world. Equity and inclusion are the core values we'd like to foster in this oncoming era of the metaverse.
content.meta: Find out about Skymon (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
